summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by LATAM Airlines Group S.A., a foreign private issuer, containing its interim consolidated financial statements for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes standard financial statements, notes, and certifications. There is no mention of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or any other corporate event. This is a routine periodic report required under the Exchange Act. The filing does not describe any deal terms or extraordinary corporate actions. Accordingly, it does not meet the criteria for classification as a special situation.
